era.MNG: The Mongols: the Steppe and the Great Empire
region.onon.intro: The Mongol heartland between the Onon and Kherlen rivers. Families move their yurts and herds four times a year, clans feud and swear brotherhood, and over everything stands the Eternal Blue Sky. Chinggis Khan came from here, and after all the conquests his descendants came back here.
region.karakorum.intro: The capital of the empire in the Orkhon valley: a mud wall, the khan's palace, quarters of Muslim merchants and Chinese craftsmen, a church, mosques and Buddhist shrines side by side. Couriers gallop in from all over the world, and herds still graze around the walls.
region.khanbaliq.intro: Khubilai's great capital on the site of old Zhongdu - Dadu in Chinese. Straight streets, paper money, a canal all the way to the Yangtze and a million subjects of every people. Here the Mongols are the ruling nation, yet even they are slowly getting used to silk and stone houses.
region.sarai.intro: The capital of the Ulus of Jochi - the Golden Horde - on the lower Volga. An adobe city of mosques and bazaars, where furs come from Rus, slaves from Crimea and silk from China. Russian princes travel here for patents to rule, and every spring the horde rides out to the steppe pastures.
region.tabriz.intro: The capital of the Ilkhans, the Mongol rulers of Iran. Persian masters build mosques of glazed tile, the vizier Rashid al-Din writes a history of the world, and every summer the Mongol nobles ride off with their tents to cool mountain pastures.
